Sunset Fest set for Wednesday

Oct 16, 2026

The community is invited to Sunset Fest from 4 to 7 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 21, at Four Freedoms Park in Cape Coral.

The city reported there will be live music, food trucks, vendors and a picture-perfect sunset.

The family-friendly event will be geared toward all ages.

Parking and entry to the park will be free.

For more information, call the park at 239-574-0804.

Four Freedoms Park is at 4818 Tarpon Court, Cape Coral.
